query: SELECT routine_name, routine_type, data_type FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = 'public' AND routine_name = 'get_or_create_chat_conversation'; SELECT parameter_name, data_type, ordinal_position FROM information_schema.parameters WHERE specific_name IN (SELECT specific_name FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_name = 'get_or_create_chat_conversation') ORDER BY ordinal_position;
